definition: a boat with sails used for cruising or racing
description: A young woman in an orange sailing jacket and a dark beanie is on the varnished wooden deck of a classic sailing boat crossing a fjord, with a big white sail above her and steep mountains on both sides. She hauls on a rope running through a wooden block, then leans over the side and cranks a metal winch as the boat picks up speed and throws a white wake behind it. She sits back at the rail with a coil of rope in her hands, looks out over the water, and finally punches a fist into the air and shouts while a second crew member steers at the wheel behind her.
